brief: Inspect and remediate the oil issue before the heat event begins, as it is a category 3 priority for work ahead of heat events per SOP-016. Because Bellview Reach is 34 years old and has an oil issue from inspection notes, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if the defect cannot be attended before the event in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period per MG-021.
